# The International Tinnitus Journal

> A peer-reviewed medical journal publishing international research on tinnitus, otolaryngology, and clinical auditory neuroscience indexed in PubMed, Scopus, and EMBASE.

The International Tinnitus Journal is a leading academic publication dedicated to advancing tinnitus research and treatment through rigorous peer review and international collaboration. The journal covers diverse clinical topics including vestibular assessment, nerve stimulation therapies, and systemic health implications of otological conditions.

## Featured Research Articles

- [Can Pupillometry Help to Choose the Right Nerve for Tinnitus Reduction?](https://www.tinnitusjournal.com/articles/can-pupillometry-help-to-choose-the-right-nerve-for-tinnitus-reduction-31884.html): Research article on pupillometry for nerve selection in tinnitus treatment
- [Can Pupillometry Help to Choose the Right Nerve | Abstract](https://www.tinnitusjournal.com/abstract/can-pupillometry-help-to-choose-the-right-nerve-for-tinnitus-reduction-31884.html): Abstract on pupillometry assessment for tinnitus nerve stimulation treatment
- [Investigating the Role of Stochastic Resonance in Tinnitus Development](https://www.tinnitusjournal.com/articles/investigating-the-role-of-stochastic-resonance-in-tinnitus-development-among-patients-with-axonal-polyneuropathy-32092.html): Research article on stochastic resonance in tinnitus with axonal polyneuropathy
- [Investigating Stochastic Resonance in Tinnitus Development | Abstract](https://www.tinnitusjournal.com/abstract/investigating-the-role-of-stochastic-resonance-in-tinnitus-development-among-patients-with-axonal-polyneuropathy-32092.html): Abstract on stochastic resonance and tinnitus in polyneuropathy patients
- [Volumetric Analysis of Root Canal Obturation Techniques Using CBCT](https://www.tinnitusjournal.com/articles/volumetric-analysis-of-root-canal-obturation-techniques-using-cbct-potential-implications-for-tinnitus-and-systemic-health-31882.html): Research article on root canal obturation techniques and tinnitus implications
- [Volumetric Analysis of Root Canal Obturation Techniques | Abstract](https://www.tinnitusjournal.com/abstract/volumetric-analysis-of-root-canal-obturation-techniques-using-cbct-potential-implications-for-tinnitus-and-systemic-health-31882.html): Abstract for CBCT volumetric analysis study on root canal obturation techniques
- [Microleakage Assessment of Bioactive Restorative Materials](https://www.tinnitusjournal.com/articles/microleakage-assessment-of-bioactive-restorative-materials-with-and-without-bonding-agents-implications-for-tinnitus-and-systemic--31883.html): Research article on bioactive restorative materials and tinnitus systemic health
- [Microleakage Assessment of Bioactive Restorative Materials | Abstract](https://www.tinnitusjournal.com/abstract/microleakage-assessment-of-bioactive-restorative-materials-with-and-without-bonding-agents-implications-for-tinnitus-and-systemic--31883.html): Abstract for microleakage assessment study on dental restorative materials
- [Air Caloric Test Using Videonystagmography in Neurotypical and Blind Adults](https://www.tinnitusjournal.com/articles/a-preliminary-study-to-explore-the-air-caloric-test-using-videonystagmography-among-neurotypical-adults-and-individuals-with-conge-32049.html): Preliminary study on air caloric testing and vestibular function assessment
- [Air Caloric Test Using Videonystagmography | Abstract](https://www.tinnitusjournal.com/abstract/a-preliminary-study-to-explore-the-air-caloric-test-using-videonystagmography-among-neurotypical-adults-and-individuals-with-conge-32049.html): Abstract on videonystagmography caloric testing across neurotypical and blind populations
